name: DAppSocial
fix_description: Function 0xbafac6bd checks allowance of storage[0x04][arg0][msg.sender] but deducts from storage[0x04][arg0][arg1]. Attacker passes a different arg1 address to bypass the allowance check while spending someone elses allowance. Fix: ensure the allowance check and deduction operate on the same address, or validate arg1 == msg.sender.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a short, direct exploit against flawed token-lock/alt-account withdrawal logic with only a few contract interactions and no flash loans, pricing, or advanced DeFi mechanics. A competent auditor could identify and reproduce the issue quickly from the protocol-specific functions `lockTokens`, `withdrawTokensWithAlt`, and `withdrawTokens`.
